Understanding Acute vs Chronic Pain – Physiotherapy in Nala Sopara

Are you dealing with back pain, neck pain, or joint pain that just won’t go away?

Many patients are confused about the difference between acute pain and chronic pain. Acute pain happens after an injury and usually improves as the body heals. Chronic pain can last more than 3 months and may continue even when scans like X-rays or MRIs look normal.

Pain does not always mean damage. Sometimes the nervous system becomes over-sensitive and keeps sending pain signals even after healing.
